title: How to Contact Instagram Customer Support
description: If you have issues or technical problems with Instagram, you can try and contact Instagram customer support.    Instagram gives you an option to contact them via their app in the support section.  They also have a detailed help center.  If your question is about missing a feature, most of the time, they will tell you that it hasn't rolled out to all users yet and to be patient.    Here are the most common issues and solutions for them in the help center.  What can I do if my account has been disabled? https://help.instagram.com/366993040048856  What can I do if I've lost access to the email I signed up with? https://help.instagram.com/358911864194456?sr=3&sid=0ZU6DLGxQgjug4PMM  Questions About Usernames https://help.instagram.com/contact/111608122342794  Instagram on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/InstagramEnglish/?brand_redir=367152833370567  Instagram on Twitter https://twitter.com/instagram  Please leave any questions on the comment section and hopefully someone can answer it.  And go through the comments to see if someone has the same question and answer!  Thank you so much for watching.  Check out the free training on how to get more followers and make money on Instagram @ www.howfinitycourse.com

textual.limitations: These records do not establish the training's terms, costs, outcomes, operator identity, or whether viewers are asked to provide information or make payments.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it primarily provides instructional guidance for contacting Instagram through in-app reporting, the Help Center, Facebook, and Twitter about account and feature problems. The frames show Instagram support menus and Help Center pages, and the request to subscribe is described as ordinary audience engagement rather than a financial or data-related condition. A separate mention of free training about making money through an external website does not establish its terms, operator, costs, outcomes, or any information or payment request.
